rationale: C03 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Both letters first describe a harmful condition, identify a specific remedial federal measure already passed by the House and pending before the relevant Senate committee, explain how the bill would address the problem, and close by urging committee action in time for enactment during the current session. The unusually close legislative-status and closing-request language goes beyond routine correspondence boilerplate. C06 and C15 also urge rapid Senate committee action, but lack C03's fuller parallel sequence and closer phrasing.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am informed that H.R. 3490, which passed the House of Representatives a short time ago and is pending before the Senate Committee on Finance
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the House of Representatives has recently passed a bill, H.R. 9313, which is now pending before the Senate Agriculture and Forestry Committee
shared_material.explanation: Both identify a numbered remedial bill, note recent House passage, and specify its pending Senate committee status in nearly the same sentence structure.

shared_material.child_excerpt: would go far toward suppressing the abuse of narcotic drugs
shared_material.parent_excerpt: This bill would authorize the Government to pay costs of transportation in cases of this kind
shared_material.explanation: Each immediately explains the pending bill as the practical federal remedy for the previously described problem.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I most sincerely hope that your Committee will consider this or a similar bill at the earliest possible time, so that it may be enacted into law during the present Session of the Congress.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I hope it will be possible for your Committee to follow up on the original law by reporting H.R. 9313 to the Senate in time for final Congressional action at the current session.
shared_material.explanation: The closing requests share a distinctive committee-action-plus-current-session enactment formula.
